:knowledge-point/canonical-example.:question/problem:
Consider the following system of equations:
${x + 2y = 8; 2x - y = 6$

Use the diagram below to determine this system's solution $(x,y)$.

![](images/6f/6f0b7960b9b4c98250741b009da2ad19c1123c5b7adf9cd5072430fb9a879dc9.png)
:knowledge-point/canonical-example.:question/worked-solution:
The solution of the system corresponds to the point of intersection of the lines.

![](images/5c/5c1c69adc880ea7cfdb5a4e0a10abd6032d2eedf0386923b94df9b7c173edd6d.png)

In this case, we have the point $(4,2)$. Therefore, the solution to the given system is $(4,2)$.
